newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea won closes weaker on smaller dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea won closes weaker on smaller dollar supply.

text.p: The won closed slightly weaker against the dollar on Tuesday due to the smaller-than-expected dollar supply from exporters, dealers said.
They said the won was also pressured by expectations that the Japanese yen would weaken against the dollar in international markets.
The won closed at the day's opening rate of 891.70, against Monday's closing of 891.50. It ranged from 891.30 to 892.20.
"Dollar positions appeared almost square and the trading range was tight all day," said a domestic bank dealer.
